indicators.name: AI hype vocabulary
indicators.why: Words like elevate, unlock, seamless, cutting-edge and top-notch are the first thing people now associate with machine-written sites. They say nothing a homeowner can check.
indicators.fix: Replace each with the concrete fact behind it: a timeline, a material, a warranty term, a town.

indicators.name: Em dash overload
indicators.why: Frequent em dashes have become a tell of generated copy, especially in headlines and short marketing lines.
indicators.fix: Use periods, commas or parentheses. Keep at most one em dash per page, if any.

indicators.name: 'Welcome to [Business]' opener
indicators.why: A welcome line wastes the most valuable words on the page.
indicators.fix: Lead with what you do, where, and how fast: 'Roof repairs in Boise, usually same week.'

indicators.name: Exclamation marks in headings
indicators.why: Shouting headlines read as low-trust advertising.
indicators.fix: Remove the exclamation mark and make the sentence itself stronger.

indicators.name: Emoji in headings, buttons or bullets
indicators.why: Emoji in UI copy is a strong vibe-coded tell and looks unprofessional for trades.
indicators.fix: Remove the emoji. Use a real icon sparingly, or nothing.

indicators.name: Generic CTA labels
indicators.why: 'Get Started', 'Learn More', 'Submit' and 'Click here' don't tell a homeowner what happens next.
indicators.fix: Name the outcome: 'Get a free inspection', 'Book a repair', 'Call (208) 555-0142'.

indicators.name: 'Whether you're X or Y' construction
indicators.why: A stock rhetorical frame common in generated copy.
indicators.fix: Say who you serve directly: 'Homes and small shops across Kent County.'

indicators.name: Three-word slogan triplet
indicators.why: 'Fast. Reliable. Affordable.' is the default tagline of every template.
indicators.fix: Replace with one specific promise you can keep.

indicators.name: Lorem ipsum or template placeholders
indicators.why: Leftover placeholder text ('Lorem ipsum', '[Company Name]', '{{city}}', 'Your text here') signals an unfinished template.
indicators.fix: Write the real copy or remove the block.

indicators.name: Unbacked superlatives
indicators.why: 'Best in town', '#1', 'highest quality' and 'unmatched' claim things the page can't prove.
indicators.fix: Swap for proof: review count with source, years in business, a warranty term.

indicators.name: Corporate jargon
indicators.why: 'Solutions', 'leverage', 'utilize', 'synergy' and 'comprehensive' make a local trade sound like a software vendor.
indicators.fix: Use plain trade language: 'repairs', 'we install', 'we fix'.

indicators.name: Hero doesn't say what or where
indicators.why: If the first screen doesn't name the trade and the town, visitors and Google both have to guess.
indicators.fix: Put the service and the city in the headline, eyebrow or first sentence.

indicators.name: Rhetorical question headlines
indicators.why: 'Looking for a reliable contractor?' is filler that delays the answer.
indicators.fix: State the answer as the headline.

indicators.name: Overlong hero subheading
indicators.why: Subheads over ~35 words get skipped on mobile.
indicators.fix: Cut to one or two sentences: what, where, what happens next.

indicators.name: Company-centric copy
indicators.why: Copy that is mostly 'we/our' and rarely 'you/your' reads as a brochure, not help.
indicators.fix: Rewrite key sentences around the homeowner's problem and outcome.

indicators.name: Title Case On Every Heading
indicators.why: Title-cased sentences read as auto-generated and are harder to scan.
indicators.fix: Use sentence case for headings longer than four words.

indicators.name: Generic section titles
indicators.why: 'Our Services', 'Why Choose Us', 'What Our Clients Say' appear on every template.
indicators.fix: Make titles specific: 'Roofing services in Boise', 'What Meridian homeowners say'.

indicators.name: Fake urgency
indicators.why: 'Act now', 'Limited time', countdown timers on a trade site erode trust.
indicators.fix: Use real, dated offers only, or none.

indicators.name: Default AI font stack
indicators.why: Inter, Poppins, Montserrat, Roboto, Open Sans or Lato as the only typeface is the default output of most generators.
indicators.fix: Pick a display face with character (see styles/) and pair it with a quiet body face.

indicators.name: Weak type hierarchy
indicators.why: When the main heading is less than ~2.2x the body size, nothing leads the eye.
indicators.fix: Scale the H1 up (clamp 2.6-5rem) and tighten its line-height.

indicators.name: Gradient text
indicators.why: Gradient-filled headline words are the signature of AI landing pages.
indicators.fix: Use a solid ink color; mark emphasis with an italic or a second color instead.

indicators.name: Small body text
indicators.why: Body text under 16px is hard to read, especially for older homeowners on phones.
indicators.fix: Set body to 16-18px.

indicators.name: Overlong line length
indicators.why: Paragraphs wider than ~90 characters tire the eye.
indicators.fix: Cap text measure around 60-75ch.

indicators.name: Centered long paragraphs
indicators.why: Centered text longer than three lines is hard to read.
indicators.fix: Left-align body paragraphs; center only short statements.

indicators.name: Pill badge above every headline
indicators.why: A small icon pill ('New', 'Rated #1') above the H1 is a template reflex.
indicators.fix: Remove it, or replace with a plain eyebrow carrying real info (trade and town).

indicators.name: Too many font families
indicators.why: More than three loaded families looks undecided and slows the page.
indicators.fix: Use one display and one body family (plus an optional mono).

indicators.name: Cramped or airy body leading
indicators.why: Body line-height under 1.35 or over 1.9 hurts reading.
indicators.fix: Set body line-height around 1.5-1.65.

indicators.name: Purple/indigo gradients
indicators.why: Indigo-to-violet gradients are the house style of generated SaaS pages and look wrong for trades.
indicators.fix: Commit to a palette from the trade's world (see styles/) with one accent.

indicators.name: Default framework blue
indicators.why: Tailwind blue (#2563eb/#3b82f6) as the brand color says 'unstyled template'.
indicators.fix: Choose a brand accent deliberately and use it consistently.

indicators.name: Mesh blobs and glowing orbs
indicators.why: Blurred gradient blobs behind content are pure decoration with an AI look.
indicators.fix: Remove them. Let photography and type carry the page.

indicators.name: Low-contrast text
indicators.why: Text below WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text) is unreadable outdoors on a phone.
indicators.fix: Darken text or lighten backgrounds until AA passes.

indicators.name: No color commitment
indicators.why: Black on white with grey-50 bands and no brand color feels anonymous.
indicators.fix: Introduce a paper tone or brand color field and one accent.

indicators.name: Too many accent colors
indicators.why: Buttons and links in more than three saturated colors make the page noisy.
indicators.fix: One primary accent for actions; one optional secondary.

indicators.name: AI-builder dark aesthetic
indicators.why: Black background, dotted grid, glowing gradient borders: the look of AI tools, not a local business.
indicators.fix: Use a real dark palette with texture from photos, or go light.

indicators.name: Generic centered hero
indicators.why: Centered headline, subline and two buttons over nothing is the default template hero.
indicators.fix: Use a hero with a real photo, a form or a strong editorial headline; show proof under the CTA.

indicators.name: Three identical icon cards
indicators.why: A row of three cards, each an icon in a tinted square plus a title and two grey lines, is the most recognisable template block.
indicators.fix: Use a numbered list, photo tiles or a split list with real service detail.

indicators.name: Monotonous section rhythm
indicators.why: Every section built the same way (centered H2, subtitle, grid) makes the page feel generated.
indicators.fix: Vary layouts: split, list, full-bleed photo, quote.

indicators.name: Alternating grey bands only
indicators.why: White/grey-50 alternation as the only separation is a template default.
indicators.fix: Use rules, color fields or photography to separate sections.

indicators.name: Rounded-and-shadowed everything
indicators.why: Large radius plus soft drop shadow on every element is the stock component-library look.
indicators.fix: Pick a shape language: crisp corners, or rounded without shadows, and apply it consistently.

indicators.name: Round-number stat counters
indicators.why: '500+ projects, 10+ years, 100% satisfaction' rows are usually invented and always generic.
indicators.fix: Show only real, specific numbers with a source, or remove the row.

indicators.name: 'Trusted by' logo cloud
indicators.why: Grey brand logos under the hero are a SaaS pattern; for a local trade they're often fake.
indicators.fix: Replace with real certifications, review sources or local affiliations.

indicators.name: Horizontal scroll on mobile
indicators.why: Content wider than the phone screen breaks the page.
indicators.fix: Find the overflowing element and constrain it (max-width: 100%, wrap, grid minmax).

indicators.name: Too many hero actions
indicators.why: More than two buttons in the hero splits attention.
indicators.fix: One primary action plus the phone number.

indicators.name: Only stock photography
indicators.why: Stock or generated photos everywhere tell visitors the business has nothing to show.
indicators.fix: Use real job, crew and before/after photos. Label any placeholder until replaced.

indicators.name: AI image tells
indicators.why: Warped hands, gibberish signage, plastic skin, impossible roofs and tools are instantly noticed.
indicators.fix: Replace with real photos, or carefully chosen real stock.

indicators.name: Cheesy stock poses
indicators.why: Thumbs-up, handshakes, hard-hat-pointing-at-clipboard and headset agents read as fake.
indicators.fix: Use candid work photos: hands, tools, materials, the finished result.

indicators.name: Muddy dark overlay
indicators.why: A heavy black overlay on the hero kills the photo.
indicators.fix: Use a directional gradient where the text sits and let the rest of the photo breathe.

indicators.name: 3D clay or isometric illustrations
indicators.why: Clay renders and isometric scenes are SaaS decoration, not trade.
indicators.fix: Use photography.

indicators.name: Images without dimensions
indicators.why: Images without width/height attributes cause layout shift while loading.
indicators.fix: Add width and height (or aspect-ratio).

indicators.name: Oversized images
indicators.why: Images several times larger than their display size waste mobile data.
indicators.fix: Serve responsive sizes with srcset.

indicators.name: Missing alt text
indicators.why: Images without alt text fail accessibility and lose local SEO context.
indicators.fix: Describe the job: 'New architectural shingle roof on a two-story home in Meridian'.

indicators.name: Generic AI logo
indicators.why: An icon-plus-name logo in a default font looks auto-generated.
indicators.fix: Use the business's real logo, or a typographic wordmark in the display face.

indicators.name: Sparkle and magic icons
indicators.why: Sparkles and magic wands mean 'AI'. They make no sense on a trade site.
indicators.fix: Remove them.

indicators.name: Icons in tinted squircles
indicators.why: Every card with an icon inside a pastel rounded square is the component-library default.
indicators.fix: Drop the tinted container; use icons sparingly or not at all.

indicators.name: Emoji bullets
indicators.why: Lists that start with check, wrench or house emoji look like a chat message, not a business.
indicators.fix: Use plain bullets, numbers or a consistent check icon.

indicators.name: Glassmorphism
indicators.why: Frosted translucent cards are decoration borrowed from app UIs.
indicators.fix: Use solid surfaces.

indicators.name: Decorative blobs, waves and dots
indicators.why: Shapes that don't relate to the business add noise.
indicators.fix: Remove, or replace with a motif from the trade (e.g. contour lines for landscaping).

indicators.name: Checkmark lists everywhere
indicators.why: More than four checklists on a page turns every claim into the same shape.
indicators.fix: Keep checklists for what's included; write the rest as sentences.

indicators.name: Gradient or glowing borders
indicators.why: Animated or gradient borders and neon glows are AI-tool styling.
indicators.fix: Use a solid 1px rule or no border.

indicators.name: Shadows on everything
indicators.why: Heavy drop shadows on most elements flatten hierarchy.
indicators.fix: Reserve shadow for one floating element at most.

indicators.name: SaaS pricing tiers
indicators.why: 'Basic / Pro / Enterprise' monthly tiers don't fit quote-based trades.
indicators.fix: Show price ranges, what affects price and financing, or a free estimate.

indicators.name: FAQ answers that dodge
indicators.why: 'Contact us for details' answers waste the FAQ.
indicators.fix: Answer honestly with ranges, timelines and conditions.

indicators.name: Anonymous testimonials
indicators.why: Quotes with no name, town or source (or with stock avatars) read as invented.
indicators.fix: Use real reviews with first name, town and source (Google, Facebook, Yelp).

indicators.name: Auto-rotating carousel
indicators.why: Sliders hide content and are rarely read past the first slide.
indicators.fix: Show the best items statically.

indicators.name: Long quote form
indicators.why: More than six fields cuts quote requests.
indicators.fix: Ask for name, phone, what's needed, ZIP and optional details.

indicators.name: Placeholder-only form fields
indicators.why: Fields with no visible label lose their prompt as soon as you type.
indicators.fix: Add visible labels.

indicators.name: Newsletter signup
indicators.why: Homeowners don't subscribe to a roofer's newsletter; the box adds clutter.
indicators.fix: Remove, or replace with a seasonal reminder signup only if it is real.

indicators.name: Chat bubble covers the call button
indicators.why: Floating widgets that overlap the mobile call bar block the main action.
indicators.fix: Move or remove the widget on mobile.

indicators.name: Dead or placeholder links
indicators.why: Links (and social icons) pointing to '#' or javascript:void make the site feel fake.
indicators.fix: Point every link somewhere real or remove it.

indicators.name: Popups on load
indicators.why: Modals or banners covering the screen on load block the phone number.
indicators.fix: Remove load popups; keep cookie notices small.

indicators.name: Everything fades up on scroll
indicators.why: Scroll-reveal on every block is the signature of generated sites and hides content from slow devices.
indicators.fix: Remove reveal animations, or keep one subtle one.

indicators.name: Infinite marquee
indicators.why: Scrolling ticker strips of logos or words are decoration with no information.
indicators.fix: Replace with a static row of real proof.

indicators.name: Ignores reduced motion
indicators.why: Animations that ignore prefers-reduced-motion can make people sick.
indicators.fix: Wrap animations in a prefers-reduced-motion check.

indicators.name: Rotating or typewriter headline
indicators.why: Animated headline words delay the one sentence that matters.
indicators.fix: Use a static headline.

indicators.name: Unverifiable big numbers
indicators.why: '10,000+ happy customers', '99% satisfaction', '#1 rated' with no source look invented, and often are.
indicators.fix: Use real numbers with a source and date, or remove them.

indicators.name: Ratings without a source
indicators.why: A star rating with no review count or platform is meaningless.
indicators.fix: Show '4.8 from 212 Google reviews' with a link.

indicators.name: Testimonials that read as generated
indicators.why: Generic praise ('Amazing service, highly recommend') with no specifics sounds fake.
indicators.fix: Use real reviews that mention the job, the town and what happened.

indicators.name: Unbacked badges
indicators.why: 'Award-winning' or 'Certified' with no issuer reads as filler.
indicators.fix: Name the issuer and the year, or remove it.

indicators.name: No license, insurance or location
indicators.why: Trades are expected to show a license number, insurance and a real location.
indicators.fix: Add the license number, 'Licensed and insured', and an address or service area.

indicators.name: Stale copyright year
indicators.why: An old copyright year suggests the business may be closed.
indicators.fix: Use the current year (generate it).

indicators.name: Placeholder content left live
indicators.why: Sample reviews, stock-photo tags, example.com emails and 555 numbers must not ship.
indicators.fix: Replace every sample with the business's real info before launch.

indicators.name: Phone not visible on first screen
indicators.why: Most trade customers call. The number must be on the first screen, on phones too.
indicators.fix: Put the number in the header and the hero.

indicators.name: Phone not click-to-call
indicators.why: A phone number that isn't a tel: link forces people to copy it.
indicators.fix: Wrap every phone number in a tel: link.

indicators.name: No quote action above the fold
indicators.why: Without a free estimate/quote action on the first screen, people bounce.
indicators.fix: Add one primary action to the hero linking to a short form.

indicators.name: No service area
indicators.why: Visitors need to know you come to their town, and Google needs it for local search.
indicators.fix: List the towns you serve on the home page and on a service-area page.

indicators.name: No sticky call bar on mobile
indicators.why: On phones the call and quote actions should always be one tap away.
indicators.fix: Add a fixed bottom bar with Call and Free quote.

indicators.name: No 'what happens next' promise
indicators.why: Forms convert better when they say when you'll hear back.
indicators.fix: Add a line like 'We call back within 2 business hours.'

indicators.name: Vague services
indicators.why: 'Residential and commercial solutions' doesn't tell people if you do their job.
indicators.fix: List specific services, each with what's included.

indicators.name: Emergency trade without an emergency path
indicators.why: Plumbers, roofers, HVAC and electricians get urgent calls; the site should route them.
indicators.fix: Add an emergency line or banner if the business takes urgent work.

indicators.name: No hours
indicators.why: Hours tell callers when someone will pick up.
indicators.fix: Show hours in the header, footer and contact page.

indicators.name: Contact page is only a form
indicators.why: A contact page without phone, hours and area makes people wonder if anyone is there.
indicators.fix: Add phone, hours, service area and address next to the form.

indicators.name: Focus outlines removed
indicators.why: outline: none without a replacement makes the site unusable by keyboard.
indicators.fix: Add a visible :focus-visible style.

indicators.name: Small tap targets
indicators.why: Links and buttons smaller than 24px fail WCAG 2.2 AA and are hard to tap with work gloves or a thumb.
indicators.fix: Make interactive targets at least 24x24px (ideally 44x44px) on mobile.

indicators.name: Heading structure broken
indicators.why: Missing or multiple H1s confuse screen readers and search engines.
indicators.fix: One H1 per page, then H2s in order.

indicators.name: Missing or generic page titles
indicators.why: Titles like 'Home', 'React App' or the same title on every page hurt search and tabs.
indicators.fix: Title each page: 'Roof repair in Boise, ID | Ridgeline Roofing'.

indicators.name: Missing meta description
indicators.why: Without one, Google writes its own snippet from random page text.
indicators.fix: Add a 140-160 character description with the service and town.

indicators.name: No LocalBusiness schema
indicators.why: Structured data helps Google show hours, area and ratings.
indicators.fix: Add JSON-LD with the right LocalBusiness subtype (e.g. RoofingContractor).

indicators.name: Heavy JavaScript for a brochure site
indicators.why: Hundreds of KB of JS for static content slows phones on job sites.
indicators.fix: Ship static HTML and CSS; keep JS minimal.

indicators.name: No viewport meta
indicators.why: Without it, phones render the desktop layout zoomed out.
indicators.fix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">.

indicators.name: Default framework favicon
indicators.why: A Vite/React/Next logo in the browser tab says 'template'.
indicators.fix: Use the business mark or initial as the favicon.
